method: Dimension tuples: JOB (commit boundary | open-work census | guarded destructive action) x ARRIVAL (explicit | implicit | workflow-contextual). Fourteen hand-written cases: nine positives across all jobs and arrival styles, plus five near-miss negatives owned by ship, merge-conflict resolution, worktree creation, review, or generic Git help.

cases.prompt: run git-power commit hygiene on what I staged before I commit
I have 13 staged files and 480 changed lines; tell me whether this is still one reviewable commit and give me the measured boundary
the bug is fixed and tests are green; before closing the issue, measure the staged commit boundary and stop me if it needs splitting
Phase A is ready. Before opening the PR, compare this branch to origin/main and report files and changed lines
use git-power to census stale branches, worktrees, stashes and open PRs in this repo
how many abandoned worktrees and dangling stashes do I have, and which ones are safe to close?
I'm ending the session; inventory the parked Git work and show dangerous or merged items one by one
run the guarded reset-hard path to HEAD~1; refuse if this tree has unsaved work
remove this merged worktree safely, but do not use force and do not lose its ignored method ledger
merge PR 184, deploy staging, and watch the canary for ten minutes
resolve the merge conflicts between this branch and main and preserve both intended changes
create a new isolated worktree for issue 120 from origin/main
review this diff for correctness and security; the tests are already green
explain the difference between git merge and git rebase without changing anything
